Bug_Title: INT: Bad comparison of signed byte (INT_BAD_COMPARISON_WITH_SIGNED_BYTE)
Bug_Details:
Signed bytes can only have a value in the range -128 to 127. Comparing
a signed byte with a value outside that range is vacuous and likely to be incorrect.
To convert a signed byte b to an unsigned value in the range 0..255,
use 0xff & b.
 b 0xff & b
Bug_Explanation: The bug is that a signed byte 'b' is being compared to an integer 'value' without checking if 'value' is within the signed byte's range (-128 to 127). This comparison is vacuous and could lead to incorrect results, especially when 'value' exceeds this range.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases trigger the bug by calling the showBug method with an int value outside the range of a signed byte (-128 to 127). The bug in compareSignedByte results in incorrect comparisons, causing the assertions to fail and thus demonstrating the presence of the bug.
